title: 第4619章 生祭第4618章 不可直视不可触碰
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: “一尊石像，胸口有个空洞。还有这些刻痕。”
唐天指了指凹坑上的字迹。
“这是师尊刻的。他在提醒后人，对付那个东西不能用常规手段。直视它会让人陷入幻觉，触碰它会被它同化。”
玄寂蹲下身仔细看了一会儿，神色变得越来越凝重。
“那什么方式能用？”
唐天问道。
玄寂沉默了一下：“师尊的手记里写过一段，但那段被腐蚀得太厉害，只剩几个字了。如果没记错的话，那几个字应该是……生祭。”
“生祭？”
“对。用活物的气血之力作为诱饵，把它引到某个固定的位置，然后封死那个位置。当年师尊本来准备用自己做诱饵，但在临门一脚的时候被那东西察觉了，没成功。”
“如果只是诱饵的话，那不需要用活人。用我那块圆盘就行了。紫君打造的那块圆盘里，封存的是我自己的气血之力，那东西感应到的只会是纯正的肉身气息。”
唐天听完，摸了摸下巴，若有所思地说。
“这个办法可行。只要它被引到封印位置上，剩下的就是催动封印把它锁住。”
玄寂听完，眼睛微微一亮。
“封印在哪？”
唐天眉头微挑。
“就在石像正下方。那封印是被师尊以自身全部修为加固过的，只要诱饵到位，封印就能自行运转。但有个问题……那东西一旦被引到封印上，诱饵也会被封进去。”
玄寂指向凹坑中心，那尊石像脚下。
“那就让它封进去。”
唐天毫不犹豫，“圆盘里面封的气血之力，本来就是从我自己身上抽的，丢了就丢了。”
“可如果你的气血之力被封在那道封印里，你自身的实力也会受损。”
玄寂神色凝重的说道：“气血之力不是灵气，损耗了恢复得很慢。”
“够用就行，我也没打算单靠蛮力打穿它。只要能把它锁住，三年之内我再想办法彻底解决。”
唐天摆手，浑不在意。
“你心里有数就行。我去准备催动封印的东西，你在这里等我。”
玄寂说着转身快步离开。
唐天一个人在凹坑边缘站了一会儿，低头看着那尊石像。
石像的面容虽然模糊，却莫名让他想起玄溟上人最后那个笑容。
那笑容里带着释然，也带着一点没说完的话。
玄寂离开后，唐天独自蹲在凹坑边缘，仔仔细细观察那尊石像。
石像的面容模糊，但他隐隐觉得那双空洞的眼窝里曾经有过什么。
也许是一双注视着裂缝无数年的眼睛，也许是玄溟上人最后残留的意识。
他伸手轻轻碰了一下石像的肩膀，触感粗粝冰冷，和普通石头没有任何区别。
但当他收回手的时候，指尖却沾了一层极薄的灰色粉末。
粉末在接触到混沌之力的瞬间，发出细微的嘶嘶声，然后迅速蒸发。
“连石头都被侵蚀成这样了。”
唐天将手上的粉末拍干净，绕着石像又走了一圈。
石像背后还有几行刻痕，比正面那些更浅，像是刻的时候力气已经不够了。
“不可被它认出……否则它将会顺着气息追来……”
唐天默念了一遍，心里有了底。
也就是说他不能暴露自己的本源气息，否则那东西会直接锁定他。
content_en:
"A stone statue with a hollow in the chest. And these carvings."
Tang Tian pointed to the writing on the pit.
"This is what Master carved. He is reminding future generations that you cannot use conventional means to deal with that thing. Looking directly at it will make people fall into hallucinations, and touching it will make people assimilated by it."
Xuanji squatted down and looked carefully for a while, his expression became more and more solemn.
"What method can be used?"
Tang Tian asked.
Xuanji was silent for a moment: "There was a paragraph written in Master's notes, but that paragraph was so corroded that only a few words remained. If I remember correctly, those words should be...life sacrifice."
"Living sacrifice?"
"Yes. Use the energy and blood of a living creature as a bait, lead it to a fixed position, and then seal that position. Back then, the master planned to use himself as a bait, but he was noticed by the thing when he was about to attack, and it failed."
"If it's just a bait, then you don't need to use a living person. Just use my disk. The disk made by Zijun contains the power of my own blood and blood, and what that thing senses will only be the pure breath of the flesh."
After listening to this, Tang Tian touched his chin and said thoughtfully.
"This method is feasible. As long as it is guided to the seal position, the rest is to activate the seal to lock it."
After hearing this, Xuanji's eyes lit up slightly.
"Where is the seal?"
Tang Tian raised his eyebrows slightly.
"It's right under the stone statue. The seal was reinforced by Master with all his cultivation. As long as the bait is in place, the seal can operate on its own. But there is a problem... Once the thing is attracted to the seal, the bait will also be sealed in."
Xuanji pointed to the center of the pit, at the foot of the stone statue.
"Then let it be sealed in."
Tang Tian did not hesitate, "The power of qi and blood sealed in the disk was originally extracted from myself. If I lose it, I will lose it."
"But if your energy and blood are sealed in that seal, your own strength will also be damaged."
Xuanji said solemnly: "The power of qi and blood is not spiritual energy. Once it is lost, it will recover very slowly."
"It's enough. I don't plan to break it through with brute force alone. As long as it can be locked, I will find a way to completely solve it within three years."
Tang Tian waved his hand and didn't care.
"As long as you know what's going on, I'll prepare the tools to activate the seal. You wait for me here."
Xuanji said, turned around and left quickly.
Tang Tian stood alone on the edge of the pit for a while, looking down at the stone statue.
Although the face of the stone statue was blurry, it inexplicably reminded him of Master Xuanming's last smile.
There was relief in that smile, but also some unfinished words.
After Xuanji left, Tang Tian squatted alone on the edge of the pit and carefully observed the stone statue.
The face of the stone statue was blurry, but he vaguely felt that there had been something in those empty eye sockets.
Maybe it's a pair of eyes that have been watching the cracks for countless years, maybe it's the last remaining consciousness of Master Xuanming.
He reached out and lightly touched the stone statue's shoulder. It felt rough and cold, no different from ordinary stone.
But when he took his hand back, his fingertips were covered with a very thin layer of gray powder.
The moment the powder comes into contact with the power of chaos, it makes a subtle hissing sound and then quickly evaporates.
"Even the stones have been eroded like this."
Tang Tian wiped the powder off his hands and walked around the stone statue again.
There are a few lines of carvings on the back of the stone statue, which are shallower than those on the front, as if the strength was not enough when carving.
"Don't be recognized by it... otherwise it will follow the breath and chase you..."
Tang Tian read it silently and felt confident.
In other words, he cannot expose his original aura, otherwise the thing will directly lock onto him.
